import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*|-?\d+)\s*$")

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0]
    for statement in line.split(";"):
        match = assignment.fullmatch(statement)
        if match:
            name, expression = match.groups()
            values[name] = values[expression] if expression.isidentifier() else int(expression)

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; c ?= {values['c']}; "
    f"d ?= {values['d']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
